name: Cynthia Marguerite
original_name: シンシア・マルグリット
source: [spoiler]Little sister of [url=/c12784]Fiacca Marguerite[/url]. Lived in the end of the Oedipus Wars. Had developed a space leap technology; when it was clear the military was going to use it for the war she sealed herself in the Terminal (the control center) and made it leap from conventional space. To make a space leap both the terminal and devices are needed; Cynthia discovered the last device is in Tatsuya's world, and so has meet him and they started cooperating in its search.[/spoiler]
